formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : ℕ), ∀ (x2 x3 : ℕ) (x4 : Fin x2 → Fin x3 → Prop) [x5 : (x5 : Fin x2) → (x6 : Fin x3) → Decidable (x4 x5 x6)], (∀ (x6 : Fin x2), (Finset.filter (x4 x6) Finset.univ).card = (0 : ℕ) ∨ (3 : ℕ) ≤ (Finset.filter (x4 x6) Finset.univ).card) → (∀ (x7 : Fin x3), (Finset.filter (Function.swap x4 x7) Finset.univ).card = (0 : ℕ) ∨ (3 : ℕ) ≤ (Finset.filter (Function.swap x4 x7) Finset.univ).card) → (∀ (x8 x9 : Fin x2) (x10 x11 : Fin x3), x4 x8 x10 → x4 x9 x10 → x4 x8 x11 → x4 x9 x11 → x8 = x9 ∨ x10 = x11) → ∀ (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x9 → (∀ (x11 : Fin x2 → Bool) (x12 : Fin x3 → Bool), x9.eval (List.ofFn x11 ++ List.ofFn x12) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x13 : Fin x2) (x14 : Fin x3), x4 x13 x14 ∧ x11 x13 = Bool.true ∧ x12 x14 = Bool.true)) → ∑ x12 : Fin x2, (Finset.filter (x4 x12) Finset.univ).card ≤ x1 * (x9.size + (1 : ℕ))
plain_statement: There is a constant c such that for every relation between two finite sets with no 4-cycle and every degree, on both sides, 0 or at least 3: a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, that is true exactly when some related pair has both its inputs on has at least (pairs)/c - 1 gates.
